skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Step 3 — Score and flag entries': 'say what the weighting was' but no weights or score bands are defined, so scores and the 'high priority' cut-off are invented per run and not comparable between runs.

SKILL.md 'Step 2 — Timing': 'Back-dated entries — posting date later than effective date' fires on every routine close entry (6 of 7 here, posted 1-4 Oct for 30 Sep); no window is given and the 'Legitimate period-end entries' edge case does not say how to separate them without a baseline.

SKILL.md 'Gate 3' table has no question for the period close dates, yet 'Entries to prior closed periods' and 'after the close cutoff' ([auto]) cannot run without them; the sample only works because intake volunteers the August close date.

SKILL.md 'Step 1' and 'Output Quality Standards' require a baseline 'derived from prior periods' and a manual-vs-system split, but the manual upload checklist ('Ask the user to upload the data') never asks for prior periods or a source field; no fallback wording for a single-period upload.
SKILL.md 'Gate 3': 'Authorization thresholds — Required for the just-below test' but 'just below' is not quantified (within 1%? 5%?).

SKILL.md 'Step 8' Sheet 9 / 'Grounding' ('every flagged entry traces to a tool result') and the description ('from their Mosofin workspace') are Mosofin-only; the manual-mode section says 'every step is [manual]' while Part B labels still read [auto], which is confusing on upload.

SKILL.md is a single 59 KB file with Gates 0-2, write guardrails and Step 9 interleaved; the upload path must skip roughly 40% of it, and 'Gate 3' asks ~12 questions with no stated default for most ('Where the files do not answer ... apply its stated default' has nothing to apply for known risk areas, topside entries, who may see the output).
sample_defects: Key ignores other anomalies the data supports: JE-0903 12,400 > 10,000 approval threshold with no approver column; JE-0902 'Prepaid insurance release' posted to 6100 Rent; JE-0906 interest credited to 2500 Term Loan. If these are unintended, the sample data is noisier than the key; if intended, the key is incomplete.
JE-0905 (posted Sat 2025-09-20) and JE-0907 (posted Sat 2025-10-04) are weekend postings too, so 'posted on a Sunday' is not unique to JE-0904 as the key implies.

No approver, source (manual/system) or timestamp column and only one period, so 4 approval indicators, baseline and reversal tests are structurally untestable; the key does not say the run should report them NOT RUN.
